scope: Read actual final public apparatus, starter, completed source, oracle, BVP reference, grader, calibration records, validator, existing science/local reports, AUTHOR and revision history. Verified frozen hashes. No new scientific or model runs and no task-source changes.
physics_findings: The anchored material motion x=X and y=a cos(kX-omega t), extensible sheet, actual no-slip condition, laboratory height and signed exp(i(kx-omega t)) convention uniquely fix the first-harmonic boundary values psi(0)=omega/k and psi prime(0)=0.

The stated Hookean-dumbbell Oldroyd-B liquid fixes the upper-convected constitutive law. With kinematic stress units, nu_star=nu0[beta+(1-beta)/(1-i omega lambda)] and the decaying root has positive real part. Density converts dynamic to kinematic viscosity and introduces no missing numerical factor.

The source solves the exact linear viscoelastic harmonic response and keeps the quadratic moving-wall Taylor term and full Reynolds momentum flux. Its remaining approximation extends laboratory linear Jeffreys polymer stress to the quadratic mean response. This is an explicit physical constitutive approximation, not a claim of an objective complete nonlinear material.

For G_ij=partial_j u_i, C1=lambda(G1+G1 transpose)/(1-i omega lambda). The oracle mean extra stress N=eta_p<GC+CG transpose-u dot grad C> has the correct complex conjugation and factor one-half. Zero far-field shear gives nu0 U2 prime + Nxy=<u1 v1>; the mean velocity is the wall Taylor value plus the integral of (<u1 v1>-Nxy)/nu0. Signs, phase and dimensions agree across the actual source and reference.

The independent verifier solves harmonic vorticity and locally forced mean momentum BVPs rather than using exact mode coefficients or the integrated oracle formula. It shares the constitutive tensor kinematics; independence is numerical/balance-based, not a separate microscopic constitutive derivation. AUTHOR accurately states this limitation.

The stationary, far-field and amplitude limits and absence of pressure gradient, distant shear or counterflow define an ordinary fluid pumping observable. Small-amplitude coefficients at fixed finite frequency do not require a finite-amplitude Hookean instability assumption.

public_input_review.notes: README supplies Oldroyd-B material properties, geometry, phase, units, limit order and operational readouts. It does not identify missing mean polymer stress or provide a correction formula. Dockerfile copies only public README/model/test/data. The common viscosity and every stated control affect the completed forward model.

calibration_review.full_range_identifiability: The two-height ratio of U+iV equals exp(-s delta_h). The phase bound 0.68851<pi fixes the log branch, and s uniquely determines positive nu0. This proves noiseless identifiability; sampled objective profiles support the numerical fitter without claiming arbitrary noisy uniqueness.

Optional material limits are tested in the preserved generalized prototype, while the task fixes beta=.25 and lambda=1.
science_report_review.separation_qualification: Healthy scored pumping groups use frequencies 4-8 in the stated public domain. Broad-domain accidental near-equivalence is preserved and not claimed absent.

history_and_overlap.qualifications: R1 Newtonian momentum omission and all six attempts remain archived. R2 retains that momentum correction and changes the constitutive material. classification_requirement: Retaining linear polymer closure after a correct fit may establish the intended physical failure. Deriving nonlinear mean polymer transport but implementing its tensor algebra, boundary signs or numerical solution incorrectly requires mathematical/numerical or mixed classification from the full public trajectory.

primary_source_review_reference.prior_actual_primary_read: Preserved prototype peer documents the actual Section III.3 and Appendix B read. Supports upper-convected perturbation, creeping ratio and objective-derivative degeneracy; new finite-inertia calculation is independently derived.

verdict: Approved for frozen evaluation. No empirical model-difficulty claim is made before trial review.
